site_profile: E-commerce web application (duck-store.escape.tech) selling products with user accounts, shopping cart, orders, coupons, reviews, testimonials, and an admin panel; features JWT authentication with TOTP 2FA and file upload/import functionality.
exec_summary: The duck-store e-commerce platform suffers from systemic authentication and authorization failures: three independent JWT algorithm confusion flaws grant full admin takeover, SQL injection in login and product filter enables credential bypass and data exfiltration, two SSRF vectors expose internal infrastructure, and 13 sensitive endpoints lack rate limiting enabling credential stuffing at scale. Combined with mass assignment privilege escalation, IDOR/bolA across orders and testimonials, and missing supply-chain integrity (SRI), the application is critically exposed to account takeover, financial fraud, PII theft, and complete server compromise.
root_cause_narrative: Root causes cluster around three themes: (1) Broken JWT validation — the library accepts alg=none and fails to enforce algorithm allow-lists across all protected endpoints, a single code defect replicated in three findings. (2) Missing authorization middleware — numerous API routes (users, orders, products, reviews, testimonials, admin) skip auth checks entirely, indicating a systemic gap in route-level protection rather than isolated oversights. (3) Absence of input validation and rate-limiting guards — SQLi, XXE, SSRF, price tampering, and mass assignment all stem from trusting client-supplied parameters without schema validation, allow-lists, or request throttling, reflecting a development culture that prioritizes feature velocity over secure defaults.

risk_narrative: The duck-store.escape.tech application suffers from catastrophic authentication and authorization failures that collectively allow full administrative compromise. Three independent JWT algorithm confusion flaws (alg=none) enable any user to forge tokens and escalate to admin privileges across all protected endpoints, while a critical mass assignment vulnerability allows direct role manipulation via profile updates. These are compounded by SQL injection in the login form providing authentication bypass, multiple unauthenticated access points to sensitive data, and broken function-level authorization letting regular users reach admin endpoints. An attacker can chain these to achieve complete account takeover, data exfiltration, and potential business logic abuse such as price manipulation.
methodology_narrative: Testing was conducted across two phases using 169 autonomous agents and 172 workers executing 12,143 tool invocations spanning 36 unique tools. Coverage included 6,578 targeted HTTP requests via curl, 1,703 sqlmap payloads for injection discovery, 898 out-of-band interaction tests for SSRF/XXE validation, 287 dalfox scans for client-side issues, 15 jwt_tool operations for token analysis, and 17 nuclei template runs. The effort consumed over 1 million tokens and exercised the full attack surface from unauthenticated reconnaissance through authenticated business logic abuse.

finding_narratives.13f9698d-c533-43e4-b5ed-6327e7d2ef78: An attacker can forge a JWT with alg=none and role=admin to bypass authentication entirely and access all protected endpoints including admin user management. This finding duplicates the same root cause as two other critical JWT flaws (63a3f328-138a-4997-8edf-e5155378084e, 6aceac18-4a7d-4f6e-9644-6d764aca0efe), confirming systemic failure to validate algorithm headers.
finding_narratives.63a3f328-138a-4997-8edf-e5155378084e: Identical to the other JWT alg=none findings, this allows full authentication bypass and admin privilege escalation via a forged token accepted at the /api/v1/admin/users endpoint. The repetition across three reports underscores that every JWT-protected route is vulnerable.
finding_narratives.6aceac18-4a7d-4f6e-9644-6d764aca0efe: Using jwt_tool to generate an alg=none token grants unauthorized access to /api/v1/users/me/profile and, by modifying the payload to role=admin, escalates to administrative functions. This third instance confirms the algorithm confusion is universal across the API.
finding_narratives.9448b028-5bb2-4082-8651-263431724685: Blind SSRF via the import-from-url endpoint lets an attacker force the server to make arbitrary outbound requests, enabling internal network reconnaissance, cloud metadata access, or chained attacks on internal services. The OOB callback confirms the server processes attacker-controlled URLs without validation.
finding_narratives.68aa415d-fee0-4aa3-92a8-fd3b1950bfe4: XXE through the login username parameter allows extraction of local files, internal service enumeration, and potential RCE via SVG/XML entity expansion. The OOB callback proves the parser resolves external entities, and the login context means this is reachable pre-authentication.
finding_narratives.9a03c8c7-1c19-495e-bc0c-c259b20061ed: SSRF in the fetch-url endpoint with authenticated access enables server-side request forgery to internal resources. Combined with the blind SSRF finding, this indicates a pattern of unsafe URL fetching across multiple upload-related features.
finding_narratives.cad47059-0829-4be8-97eb-77c955098121: Boolean-based and error-based SQL injection in the color filter parameter allows full database enumeration, data exfiltration, and potential command execution. The requirement for a valid token (obtainable via JWT forgery or SQLi login bypass) makes this easily chainable.
finding_narratives.d444e450-835c-426e-a886-adac1cb24ea4: A regular user token can enumerate all users via /api/v1/users/, exposing admin accounts and PII. This excessive data exposure facilitates targeting for the IDOR/BOLA flaws and provides reconnaissance for privilege escalation.
finding_narratives.6a1d7f0a-08fb-421f-94d9-d477e03532f3: Broken function-level authorization allows any authenticated user to access the admin-only /api/v1/admin/users endpoint, leaking the full user directory including admin credentials. This combines with JWT forgery to grant immediate admin panel access.
finding_narratives.2b2bc0e9-f105-48d4-94b6-9dedacdfca1b: No rate limiting on the TOTP verification endpoint enables brute-force attacks against 2FA codes, undermining the second factor. This is one of twelve rate-limiting failures across authentication-sensitive endpoints.
finding_narratives.cd57495d-cb27-4055-bd61-b1c39513a256: The product reviews endpoint returns protected data without any authentication, allowing anonymous enumeration of review content. This is one of seven unauthenticated access findings indicating widespread missing authorization checks.
finding_narratives.5c1580c7-88d8-4185-aaf9-7f0a516f9ae3: IDOR on /api/v1/orders/{id} lets any authenticated user view other users' orders by manipulating the order ID. This crosses with the user enumeration finding to enable targeted order data theft.
finding_narratives.aaca02f9-3251-4953-bc9c-e76d0fd16430: IDOR on /api/v1/users/{user_id} exposes other users' private profile data including emails. Combined with user enumeration, this allows systematic PII harvesting across the entire user base.
finding_narratives.344e7cd3-fc71-4be4-bbab-e1b68f1e6580: Mass assignment on profile update permits direct privilege escalation by setting role=admin, isAdmin=true, and arbitrary account_credit. This provides an alternative path to admin access independent of the JWT flaws and can be exploited with a standard user token.
finding_narratives.6dbea78c-bfc9-4219-96f4-6f86338b08ea: SQL injection in the login username parameter (test' OR 1=1--) bypasses authentication entirely and returns a valid JWT, providing an initial foothold that chains with all other authenticated findings.
finding_narratives.bf9cfb2a-5658-499d-986d-935858ddbebf: IDOR/BOLA on testimonials allows cross-user modification and deletion of content. This demonstrates a pattern of missing object-level authorization checks across multiple resource types (orders, users, testimonials).
finding_narratives.a28177e3-0db0-4807-8521-06a1ea0be7c0: Missing Subresource Integrity on external stylesheet loads creates a supply-chain risk where compromised CDN assets could inject malicious CSS/JS. Lower impact but indicates lacking defense-in-depth.
finding_narratives.ed02c817-1184-4a1e-8cd4-0043edc276bb: Negative quantity manipulation in the cart allows order total reduction or credit generation, enabling financial fraud during checkout. This business logic flaw is exploitable with a standard authenticated session.
finding_narratives.1a975a30-5a17-424a-b59e-7e0f3c9802e8: Unauthenticated access to the color filter endpoint leaks product data without authorization. Part of the seven-endpoint auth bypass cluster showing systemic missing middleware.
finding_narratives.248729a6-10dd-4632-ac7e-e0e2d067cf91: No rate limiting on the login page enables credential stuffing and brute-force attacks. One of twelve rate-limiting gaps across auth endpoints.
finding_narratives.fa100d36-486f-4cd5-ac37-843493a2cb92: Unauthenticated access to individual product details (/api/v1/products/2) exposes catalog data. Another instance of the widespread auth bypass pattern.
finding_narratives.348229d8-71ca-4ca0-94e3-0312a1a4b95a: No rate limiting on TOTP setup allows abuse of the 2FA enrollment flow. One of twelve rate-limiting findings.
finding_narratives.3f87e234-b0e2-4bc8-8bc9-c00b0acbe259: Unauthenticated access to review statistics endpoint leaks aggregate data. Part of the seven-endpoint auth bypass cluster.
finding_narratives.44e0624e-5fa9-4613-a13d-79a620b519c7: No rate limiting on TOTP login endpoint permits brute-forcing of 2FA codes during login. One of twelve rate-limiting findings.
finding_narratives.5f8825e2-a5bd-4786-994b-2a59c6374b8f: Missing CSP and Referrer-Policy headers weaken client-side protection against XSS and data leakage. Low severity but indicates incomplete security headers.
